lead_raw_text:
The MgCu3Se structure crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁md (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms (Mg2Cu6Se2) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers with 12 geometric neighbors (8 Cu, 4 Se), Mg centers with 10 neighbors (4 Cu, 6 Se), and Se centers with 12 neighbors (4 Cu, 8 Mg), forming a three-dimensional connected network. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cu and Mg polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Cu and Se polyhedra, indicating diverse local connectivity.
